g.text: One machined panel carries the battery, mast feet and electronics on their original mounting plane.

g.text: Each 3 mm web is deepest near the middle of the span.
At each rail the web rises into the 4 mm bearing land.
The center of the plate is 18 mm deep at a rib.
The skin between ribs is 1.7 mm thick.
